source_units.text: Compose a dedication for an imaginary book.
The style should feel intimate and grateful.
Use this fictional material: The dedication recalls an older sister keeping the spare chair beside her lamp and listening to every unfinished page.
The author thanks her with the words you waited.
Required wording, verbatim: "the spare chair", "every unfinished page", "you waited".
Use wording suitable for the fictional author's older sister.
